name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A trend's shape in currentColor, no axes — the line under every KPI tile. Decorative to assistive technology on purpose: the figure and change line beside it already say what it shows.
docs: Never the only place a trend appears; when the values matter, use @koc/chart, which has a table view. Give it a fixed height or let it fill a flex column (`flex-1`); the stroke stays 1.5px either way.
